title: Log in to reply links in ticket and case emails
summary: Ticket and case emails now have a Log in to reply button that opens the exact ticket or case after you sign in.
changes: Add a Log in to reply button to ticket and case update emails.
Signed-out readers go to the right sign-in first, public or staff, then land on the ticket or case.
Signed-in readers go straight to the ticket or case.
version_rationale: Patch: changes the button on three email templates and adds a redirect page, with no data change.
validation: New feature test for the button, staff and public sign-in, the return after sign-in and a tampered link.
Mail, workflow label, translation and architecture tests.
known_limitations: The link does not sign anyone in; readers still sign in as usual. Emails sent before this release keep their old button.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. Links in emails sent by this release will then return not found; the item is still reachable from the app.
provenance: Milestone v0.47.4 Beta, issue #468 under epic #463, pull request #594.
